fullSource:
use default

let fibonacci_sequence = stream(
    (0, 1),
    ((previous, current)) =>
        previous || (current, previous + current)
)

let fib = n => fibonacci_sequence |> skip(n) |> first()

fibonacci_sequence
    |> take(10)
    |> index()
    |> each((position, value) =>
        write_line("fib({position}) = {value}"))

write_line("fib(30) = {fib(30)}")
